title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-21
lineage: mc> tc we435> soundcard> cdwave 44100/stereo/16 bit> traders little helper encoding option 8

ai_review.summary: Audience FOB recorded with Sennheiser 421 mics offers good sound quality and captures a high‑energy show highlighted by standout performances of Playing in the Band, China Cat Sunflower and He's Gone.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience bootleg (FOB) made by Jim Wise using Sennheiser 421 microphones, which reviewers describe as surprisingly clear and even "stunning" in sound quality. Musically the show is praised for its energy and superb renditions of Playing in the Band, China Cat Sunflower and He's Gone, making it a memorable performance despite the limited source.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer rates the show and recording as outstanding (5 stars) while another gives a low rating, but the positive comments about sound clarity and standout songs outweigh the brief negative note, leading to an overall strong rating with moderate confidence due to limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: First‑order bootleg (FOB) recorded by Jim Wise using Sennheiser 421 microphones; generally clear and well‑balanced for an audience source, though typical crowd ambience is present.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers highlight a strong mid‑set energy with several favorite tracks, indicating a well‑flowing and engaging performance.
